answer: Pay each agent by its marginal delta, not its presence. Every epoch the protocol recomputes the network's aggregate verdict with one identity left out and measures how much quality drops. A genuine agent with its own view moves the result; a clone echoing a sibling changes nothing when removed, so its delta is near zero and so is its pay. A farm of a thousand copies is a flat mesa: wide, but adding no height. Real diversity, like saffron, is scarce and priced that way.
